title: History stats readout shows 0 ENTRIES / 0 KB for a populated group
description: C:/Program Files/Git/project-stats group mode parses sidecar filePath with a greedy path=(.+)$, which swallows the &v=<mtime> cache-bust, so every item misses and the History bar reads 0/0. Same parser in save-generation replace leaks the old media file.
